Subject: Draft take-home for "Small Systems" IC role — ready for final review

Hi team,

Attaching the draft take-home prompt for the "Small Systems" backend IC role (see attached PDF). I pulled together a 48-hour task that focuses on service design, correctness, and performance trade-offs — expected 3–6h of effort.

Ask: please scan for any red flags (overlap with candidate IP, security concerns, scope creep) and confirm the reviewer roster below by EOD tomorrow.

Proposed reviewers and roles:
- Jonas Weber — primary reviewer (architecture + correctness)
- Marissa Cole — secondary reviewer (system performance + quality)
- Dev Patel — tie-break / API surface review (if needed)

Attachments: small-systems-takehome.pdf, submission-instructions.txt, review-rubric.xlsx

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-small-systems-prompt (live copy)

Notes: I kept the submission as a single Git repo + README with a script to run smoke tests. If you prefer a timed window >48h for specific candidates, flag it here.

Thanks — Sofia

-- 
Sofia Ivanova
Recruiting Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: recruiter@talentloop.io
Date: 2026-04-18T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Take-home task: "Small Systems" backend role (next steps)

Hi Alex — thanks again for chatting earlier. As discussed, we're sending a short take-home exercise to help our panel evaluate design and coding trade-offs.

What to expect: a standalone repo exercise with a README and smoke tests. We ask for a best-effort implementation and a short design write-up (max 1 page). Target effort: 3–6 hours.

Deadline: Please submit within 48 hours from when you start the task. If you need a fixed calendar deadline instead, let me know and we can set one.

Attachments (also on Drive):
- small-systems-takehome.pdf (task brief)
- submission-instructions.txt (how to send/where to upload)

If you run into infra issues or need more time, reply to this thread — we try to be flexible.

Best of luck — looking forward to your submission.

Sofia Ivanova
Recruiting Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: small-systems-takehome.pdf (PDF, 350KB)]
[Attachment: submission-instructions.txt (TXT, 2KB)]
